title: Peppa Pig Theme
blurb: The Peppa Pig intro, with its snorts, its bouncing strings and its cast introducing themselves one by one. To small children it is the finest television ever made; to their parents it is a sound that arrives roughly four hundred times a week and never fully leaves the house. It has also become a full internet meme in its own right, remixed into everything from drill tracks to horror edits. Play it in any room containing a toddler and observe the effect immediately.
origin: The opening theme of Peppa Pig (Astley Baker Davies, 2004).
